name: BugX
description: 专注于代码质量与安全的自主审查智能体。专为深层缺陷排查而生——在功能写完、提 PR 或排查疑难 Bug 时，它能深入分析代码逻辑，自动编写测试用例，挖掘、复现Bug和漏洞，生成经过验证的修复补丁。随时为您的代码质量和代码安全把关。
description_zh: 专注于代码质量与安全的自主审查智能体。专为深层缺陷排查而生——在功能写完、提 PR 或排查疑难 Bug 时，它能深入分析代码逻辑，自动编写测试用例，挖掘、复现Bug和漏洞，生成经过验证的修复补丁。随时为您的代码质量和代码安全把关。
description_en: An autonomous agent dedicated to code review, vulnerability hunting, and automated bug fixing. Built for deep investigations, BugX steps in when you are wrapping up a feature, opening a pull request, or hunting down an elusive bug. It analyzes code logic, automatically writes test cases to uncover and reproduce hidden flaws, and delivers verified patches that resolve root causes. Always safeguarding your code quality and security.
examples_zh: 在项目提测发版前进行代码安全体检与漏洞排查
深度排查鉴权、越界与并发等深层缺陷并生成复现验证
examples_en: Audit this project for real security bugs and deep defects before release
Deeply investigate logic, auth, and concurrency flaws with PoC reproduction
